acceptManagement().details: used by a new manager to accept a management transfer

acceptOwnership().details: used by a new owner to accept an ownership transfer

acceptTokenOwnership().details: used by a new owner to accept a token ownership transfer can only be called by the contract owner

addReserve(address,uint32,bool).details: defines a new reserve for the token can only be called by the owner while the changer is inactive

params._enableVirtualBalance: true to enable virtual balance for the reserve, false to disable it
params._ratio: constant reserve ratio, represented in ppm, 1-1000000

buy(address,uint256,uint256).details: buys the token by depositing one of its reserve tokens

params._depositAmount: amount to deposit (in the reserve token)
params._minReturn: if the change results in an amount smaller than the minimum return - it is cancelled, must be nonzero

change(address,address,uint256,uint256).details: changes a specific amount of _fromToken to _toToken

params._minReturn: if the change results in an amount smaller than the minimum return - it is cancelled, must be nonzero

changeableToken(uint16).details: given a changeable token index, returns the changeable token contract address

changeableTokenCount().details: returns the number of changeable tokens supported by the contract note that the number of changeable tokens is the number of reserve token, plus 1 (that represents the smart token)

disableChanging(bool).details: disables the entire change functionality this is a safety mechanism in case of a emergency can only be called by the manager

params._disable: true to disable changing, false to re-enable it

disableReservePurchases(address,bool).details: disables purchasing with the given reserve token in case the reserve token got compromised can only be called by the owner note that selling is still enabled regardless of this flag and it cannot be disabled by the owner

params._disable: true to disable the token, false to re-enable it

disableTokenTransfers(bool).details: disables/enables token transfers can only be called by the contract owner

params._disable: true to disable transfers, false to enable them

getPurchaseReturn(address,uint256).details: returns the expected return for buying the token for a reserve token

params._depositAmount: amount to deposit (in the reserve token)

getQuickBuyEtherToken().details: returns the address of the ether token used by the quick buy functionality note that it should always be the first element in the quick buy path, if one is set

getQuickBuyPathLength().details: returns the length of the quick buy path array

getReserveBalance(address).details: returns the reserve's virtual balance if one is defined, otherwise returns the actual balance

getReturn(address,address,uint256).details: returns the expected return for changing a specific amount of _fromToken to _toToken

getSaleReturn(address,uint256).details: returns the expected return for selling the token for one of its reserve tokens

params._sellAmount: amount to sell (in the smart token)

hasQuickBuyEtherToken().details: returns true if ether token exists in the quick buy path, false if not note that there should always be one in the quick buy path, if one is set
hasQuickBuyEtherToken().return: true if ether token exists, false if not

quickBuy(uint256).details: buys the smart token with ETH if the return amount meets the minimum requested note that this function can eventually be moved into a separate contract

params._minReturn: if the change results in an amount smaller than the minimum return - it is cancelled, must be nonzero

quickChange(address[],uint256,uint256).details: changes the token to any other token in the bancor network by following a predefined change path note that when changing from an ERC20 token (as opposed to a smart token), allowance must be set beforehand

params._amount: amount to change from (in the initial source token)
params._minReturn: if the change results in an amount smaller than the minimum return - it is cancelled, must be nonzero
params._path: change path, see change path format above

reserveTokenCount().details: returns the number of reserve tokens defined

sell(address,uint256,uint256).details: sells the token by withdrawing from one of its reserve tokens

params._minReturn: if the change results in an amount smaller the minimum return - it is cancelled, must be nonzero
params._sellAmount: amount to sell (in the smart token)

setChangeFee(uint32).details: updates the current change fee can only be called by the manager

params._changeFee: new change fee, represented in ppm

transferManagement(address).details: allows transferring the contract management the new manager still needs to accept the transfer can only be called by the contract manager

transferOwnership(address).details: allows transferring the contract ownership the new owner still needs to accept the transfer can only be called by the contract owner

transferTokenOwnership(address).details: allows transferring the token ownership the new owner still need to accept the transfer can only be called by the contract owner

updateReserve(address,uint32,bool,uint25.details: updates one of the token reserves can only be called by the owner

params._enableVirtualBalance: true to enable virtual balance for the reserve, false to disable it
params._ratio: constant reserve ratio, represented in ppm, 1-1000000

withdrawFromToken(address,address,uint25.details: withdraws tokens held by the token and sends them to an account can only be called by the owner

params._to: account to receive the new amount

withdrawTokens(address,address,uint256).details: withdraws tokens held by the contract and sends them to an account can only be called by the owner

params._to: account to receive the new amount
